security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences and TypeScript template literals in documentation. The Bash setup and integration script examples are confirmed medium risks because they tell users to install npm packages and run local Node scripts. No prompt injection or covert data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned package installation in setup examples
remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions, document trusted registries, and tell users to inspect npm lifecycle scripts before installation.

remediation.issue: Integration script executes local Node modules
remediation.suggestion: Replace node -e require calls with explicit script files, explain expected files, and require user confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: Production API example needs security guidance
remediation.suggestion: Add input validation, authentication guidance, rate limits, and rollback steps before recommending production deployment.

content.value_statement: Reinforcement learning projects need structured setup, training loops, evaluation, and deployment checks. This skill guides AgentDB users through algorithm selection, training, benchmarking, and production rollout.
actual_capabilities: Lists nine reinforcement learning algorithms for AgentDB projects.
Shows setup steps for AgentDB learning modules and environment configuration.
Provides TypeScript training loop patterns with replay buffers and checkpointing.
Defines validation metrics for reward, success rate, baselines, and inference timing.
Outlines model export, prediction APIs, monitoring, and deployment pipelines.
limitations: Does not provide verified AgentDB package source code or API compatibility checks.
Requires users to adapt examples to their environment, dependencies, and state schema.
Does not validate model safety, reward design quality, or production controls.
Includes shell setup examples that should be reviewed before execution.

use_cases.title: Configure a Training Workflow
use_cases.description: Choose an AgentDB RL algorithm and plan environment setup, hyperparameters, replay buffers, and checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Validate Agent Performance
use_cases.description: Compare trained agents with baselines using reward, success rate, episode length, and inference timing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Production Rollout
use_cases.description: Plan model export, prediction APIs, monitoring, deployment stages, and operational readiness checks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan My AgentDB RL Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose an AgentDB reinforcement learning algorithm for this environment: [state space, action space, reward, constraints]. Include setup steps and risks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Training Loop
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a training plan for an AgentDB DQN agent with episodes, replay settings, checkpoints, and evaluation metrics. My task is: [task].

prompt_templates.title: Benchmark Trained Agents
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a validation checklist for my trained AgentDB agent. Compare it with a random baseline and define pass or fail thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Production Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my AgentDB RL deployment plan for model export, prediction API, monitoring, rollback, and operational risks. Highlight gaps before release.

output_examples.input: I need to train a grid-world navigation agent with AgentDB.
output_examples.output: A five-phase plan covering environment setup, DQN configuration, training cadence, validation metrics, and deployment checks.

output_examples.input: My trained agent improves reward, but I need release criteria.
output_examples.output: A validation checklist with baseline comparison, success rate targets, inference timing, monitoring, and rollback requirements.

output_examples.input: I want to compare PPO, DQN, and Actor-Critic for one task.
output_examples.output: A structured benchmark plan with shared metrics, consistent episode counts, and criteria for selecting the strongest approach.

best_practices: Pin package versions and review install scripts before running setup commands.
Define reward functions and success metrics before training starts.
Validate against baselines before exporting models to production.
anti_patterns: Running generated shell scripts without reviewing dependencies and local script targets.
Treating reward improvement as proof that an agent is safe for production.
Deploying an inference API without input validation, monitoring, or rollback planning.

faq.question: What algorithms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Q-Learning, SARSA, DQN, Actor-Critic, PPO, Decision Transformer, A2C, TD3, and SAC.

faq.question: Does it train a model by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and example patterns that users adapt in their own AgentDB project.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help with deployment?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines model export, prediction API setup, monitoring, and deployment pipeline planning.

faq.question: Are the examples production ready?
faq.answer: No. Users should add validation, authentication, rate limits, logging, and rollback procedures before production use.

faq.question: What should I review before running commands?
faq.answer: Review package names, versions, npm lifecycle scripts, local script targets, and any deployment environment changes.
